description: This file defines a client interface for interacting with a backend API via fetch. It includes helper functions for URL building, query parameter handling, and HTTP request functions (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). It also exports several API-specific functions such as listUsers, listSessions, listDeployments, listDashboardUsersAnalytics, and others to fetch various data from the backend. The code emphasizes scope management, sanitization, and flexible URL construction.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Detects if a URL is absolute based on the regex test.

methods.name: buildUrl(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining the base API URL with a given path or URL, handling relative and absolute URLs.

methods.name: toQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Transforms an object of parameters into a URL query string.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Checks if a URL or path pertains to the session-tracking collection root endpoint.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Sanitizes and filters query parameters based on the endpoint path, enforcing allowed parameters for security and correctness.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams(pathOrUrl, params = {})
methods.description: Ensures that query parameters include necessary scope identifiers (organization_id or tenant_id) depending on the endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams(pathOrUrl, effParams)
methods.description: Builds a URL with query parameters, merging existing queries if present.

methods.name: parseResponse(res)
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response, attempting to return JSON or text payload, with error handling.

methods.name: httpGet(pathOrUrl, { params, headers, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with scoped and sanitized query parameters, returning the parsed JSON payload.

methods.name: httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON payload (POST, PUT, etc.), handling response parsing and error throwing.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes list API responses to include items, total count, and metadata.

methods.name: getApiClient()
methods.description: Provides a minimal axios-like client with methods for get/post/put/delete.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Checks the backend health status.

methods.name: listUsers(params = {})
methods.description: Lists users filtered by organization_id with a normalized payload.

methods.name: listSessions(params = {})
methods.description: Lists session tracking records with tenant scope enforcement.

methods.name: listDeployments(params = {})
methods.description: Lists application deployments.

methods.name: listDashboardUsersAnalytics(params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches aggregated per-user analytics data.

methods.name: listLlmCosts(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of LLM costs.

methods.name: listLlmCostsUnderscore(params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of LLM costs with support for envelope format, fallback to array.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummaryStrict()
methods.description: Fetches tenant user summary ensuring only organization_id is submitted.

ctags.name: httpJson
ctags.pattern: /^async function httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal, params } = {}) {$/
